The logistics center allows for corporations to export assets between regions and access to the market. In addition, each logistics center increases the hourly buy limit by $1,000,000.

you can get Logistics center after reincorporation with 1B net worth when your season pass is level 8.

Guide[edit]

This is most important facility in this game. It unlock 3 most used feature in game. New player and post reincorporation player should focus on getting this facility as fast as possible.
